items.summary: Reject new production work, queue entries, requeues, experiments, telemetry, dependencies, deployments, spend, monetization expansion, and unsupported financial claims this cycle. Revenue is limited to one unattributed aggregate period; ROI, margin, payback, budget capacity, cost-to-learn, and causal lift remain unknown. Continue only existing repair-or-close, period-aligned attribution reconciliation, and bounded read-only legal/security evidence work. Keep private launch gates unchanged and external outreach unsent. Preserve the three cited SEO/performance opportunities as deferred backlog only.

Decline the proposed fleet execution control-plane capability for this cycle. Its operational evidence supports a future concept, but current failures, pending measurements, incomplete security and operations evidence, and conflicting cost records do not justify new scope. Do not create a proposal, queue entry, work item, telemetry request, or deployment.
